Medicare Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Appeals

  1. Home
  2. Medicare Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Appeals

Filing a Medicare DME Appeal

If you prefer not to file online, you may submit a written reconsideration request to Maximus by mail or fax.

  1. Complete the Medicare Reconsideration Request Form (opens in new tab) or prepare a written request that includes your Medicare number, the item or service being appealed, and your contact information.
  2. Sign and date your appeal request. If someone is filing on your behalf, include documentation showing they are authorized to represent you.
  3. Submit your appeal by mail or fax:

    Mail
    Maximus
    DME QIC
    3750 Monroe Ave, Suite 777
    Pittsford, NY 14534-1302

    Fax
    585-869-3314

If you have any questions about how to submit your request, refer to this helpful guide (opens in new tab).

If you’d like to request a copy of a decision letter, please click Copy of Decision | Medicare Appeals to submit a request. For additional information on this process click Decision Letter Help | Medicare Appeals.

If you have questions about your DME appeal, contact Maximus:

  • Email: DMEInfo@maximus.com
  • Phone (Suppliers): 585-348-3200
  • Fax: 585-869-3314

Medicare beneficiaries may also contact Medicare directly at 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227).

Important: Email is not a secure method of communication and may be vulnerable to interception. If your inquiry contains personal, medical, or other sensitive information, please submit it by mail or fax instead.

For information about the availability of auxiliary aids and services, visit the Medicare Nondiscrimination Notice (opens in new tab).

Accessibility & Nondiscrimination Notice

Medicare provides free auxiliary aids and services including information in braille, large print, data and audio files, relay services and TTY communications.

Any document that contains the identity of a beneficiary or a provider is confidential. For this reason, Maximus cannot accept confidential information sent via email transmission. Submit confidential information to Maximus in hard copy by US mail, commercial delivery service or via secure fax to 585-869-3314.
